The screen is ready. Open it in your browser at **http://maker:4001**

Here's what I'd like you to try first — just this one action:

> **In the box at the top, paste this link and press Save:**
> `https://martinfowler.com/articles/practical-test-pyramid.html`

Watch what happens after you press Save. You should briefly see the entry appear while it gathers the page's details, and then it should fill itself in on its own — a title, a short description, the site's little icon, a preview image, and the site name — showing up as a saved card below.

A couple of things I decided on my own here that I'd like your read on, since I picked them without asking:

- **What each saved entry shows and how it's laid out** — I chose to display the preview image on the left, with the title, description, and site name stacked to the right. Does that composition feel right to you, or would you picture a saved link differently?
- **The details it pulls in** — title, description, icon, preview image, and site name. Is that the right set, or is something missing or unnecessary?

Give it a try and tell me: does the automatic filling-in behave the way you hoped, and does the saved entry look "recognizable" the way you wanted?
